propositions: The primary completion-verify step is dispatched with no tool_step_limit, leaving it unprotected from runaway tool-call cycles that exhaust the request budget and kill the run with no verdict

Three of four measured live runs of the gate looped on repeated identical tool calls (SPLIT-A: 144 identical search_files, SPLIT-B: 62 identical search_files) wasting 40-70% of budget before dying empty
The existing max_consecutive_repeat detector is blind to cycles longer than 1 call (scores 1 for a 4-call cycle but 5 for healthy breadth), making it unsuitable as an actuator trigger
A windowed distinct-ratio over the trailing 24 tool calls (trip threshold ≤0.50) correctly identifies all three pathological runs and never fires on the healthy run (minimum 0.833 ratio)

When runaway is detected, tools must be withdrawn via steering (synthetic tool-result predicate) rather than filter-removed, because filter-removal causes Bedrock/Anthropic 400 errors when history contains toolUse blocks
Detected runaway routes into the existing bounded recovery + tool-free finalizer to emit completion_verdict from fresh per-criterion evidence rather than the poisoned looped history
